title: Faculty of Economics and Social Sciences
text:
The Faculty of Economics and Social Sciences is part of International Burch University. Its educational focus covers economics, applied economics, general economics, business economics, financial management and marketing management. The faculty aims to combine professional knowledge with problem-solving skills so that graduates can contribute to business and society. Its introduction emphasises a broad professional education and an approach centred on students.

The faculty presents three departments: the Department of Management, the Department of International Relations and European Studies, and the Department of Economics and Finance. Management emphasises mentoring, individual support, practical learning through internships and the development of critical thinking. This approach aims to prepare students to apply management knowledge in actual workplaces. The faculty also describes collaboration between students and professors, alongside contact with professionals from companies.

International Relations and European Studies focuses on social and political questions. Its listed areas include security, globalisation, migration, politics, human rights, environmental issues and global poverty. The department's introduction describes internships as mandatory and encourages students to spend part of their education abroad. This connects the subject area with practical experience and international educational opportunities.

The Department of Economics and Finance emphasises analytical and practical knowledge of developments in local and global markets. Its introduction covers banking, accounting, corporate finance, financial planning and insurance. These areas are presented as part of an education in economics and finance. Across the faculty, business simulations and technological environments help students prepare to understand business practice. Regional partners give students opportunities to observe business operations in actual working environments.

The faculty page also presents two student clubs: IBU Diplomacy Club and Business Development Club. The diplomacy club organises regular activities and events for members and the wider public, supporting efforts towards a stable and peaceful Bosnia and Herzegovina. Business Development Club connects the university with the business community and prepares students for future business experiences. The clubs therefore provide another connection between faculty life and the surrounding social and business environment.

The university's tuition page lists a 3+2+3-year study structure for this faculty: three years of undergraduate study, two years of master's study and three years of doctoral study. Tuition is grouped by study cycle and by domestic or international student category. On the same page, the university describes support for high-achieving students through partial or full exemptions from tuition payments.
